appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line rises from about 1,000 at 1880 to a peak of about 3,150 at 1890, then falls to about 2,700 at 1891; the overall start-to-end change is positive despite the final-year dip.
The line shows a small local dip from about 2,250 at 1885 to about 1,950 at 1887 before rising again.
The line climbs steeply from about 2,650 at 1888 to the 1890 peak.
The only terminal segment is a downward step from the 1890 peak to the 1891 endpoint.
